about_the_game:
With the Škoda T 27 pack, you'll get:
  • Škoda T 27 (Tier VIII Premium Czechoslovakian medium tank) with a Garage slot and crew
  • 2D style: "Establishment of Czechoslovakia"
  • 10 Buchty
  • 10 missions for ×5 XP (Škoda T 27 only)
The Škoda T 27 is a blueprint brought to life. The T 27 was part of a project to harmonize the Czechoslovakian fleet, which, at the end of the gruelling Second World War, was a jumbled and international mixture of armored vehicles. This tank is an autoloader, so you can fire bursts at your enemy before they even know you're there!
This pack comes with the "Establishment of Czechoslovakia" 2D style, and a whole bunch of Buchty, so you can really flex your national pride!

DLC can be added to your World of Tanks account only once.
Items will be credited to the first account you log in to the game with.
